scope: Compare Miami vs New York City vs Los Angeles vs San Francisco parking source feasibility for OpenParking/ParkingUSA ingestion.

notes.reference_repos: Local Referenss/ directory was not present under /Users/vladimirgrebennikov/Code/OpenParking during this heartbeat; reuse decision is based on docs/REFERENCE_REPOS.md and existing package/script reuse.
notes.live_probe: A bounded curl/python probe of Socrata and Miami Beach ArcGIS endpoints from the local terminal was attempted on 2026-07-03. data.sfgov.org DNS resolution failed locally; data.cityofnewyork.us and data.lacity.org returned 403; Miami Beach ArcGIS TLS handshakes timed out. This matrix therefore treats existing checked-in inspections and manifests as the current evidence and marks live revalidation as follow-up.

recommendation.single_easiest_path: San Francisco DataSF Parking Meters + Meter Policies is the lowest-risk immediate canonical Socrata path because local fixtures already exist, source confidence is high, legal risk is low_verify_license, meter points and daily rate/policy schedules share stable join keys, and existing scripts can dry-run Socrata inspection/import behavior.
recommendation.single_easiest_net_new_city_after_existi: Los Angeles LADOT Metered Parking Inventory & Policies + Parking Meter Occupancy is the easiest net-new expansion path because both sources are Socrata, the inventory already contains rates/rules and coordinates, and the occupancy feed gives an availability signal without browser scraping; scope must be limited to metered spaces and sensor subset first.
recommendation.do_not_pick_first: Miami operator/payment enrichment and NYC sign rules are valuable but less suitable as the first easiest next path: Miami requires browser/operator/legal review and manual evidence for City of Miami proper; NYC requires a curb-rule/sign parser and rate-zone join before it can produce user-safe rules/rates.

city_rankings.why: Best immediate path for reliable canonical meter/rate ingestion and regression benchmark; already has local fallback fixtures and inspection evidence.
manual_or_browser_evidence_needed: Conflict checks where OSM/operator candidates disagree with official meters
